title: In JetBrains YouTrack before 2026.2.19840 the attachment upload size limit could be bypassed via the REST API…
description: A vulnerability in JetBrains YouTrack before version 2026.2.19840 allows bypassing the attachment upload size limit via the REST API. This could lead to denial of service due to resource exhaustion but does not impact confidentiality or integrity. The vulnerability has a low severity score and no known exploits in the wild.
